title: Invite email recovery
lede: When invite email is unavailable, the recovery screen must say so without claiming a link was sent.

sections.heading: Same response, corrected confirmation
sections.note: Matched 390 × 844 Chromium captures. Both use the same mocked unconfigured-email response, account, route, clock, scroll position and appearance. This is DB-free UI evidence.

pairs.title: Email is not configured
pairs.beforeCap: The message says email is unavailable, but the button claims Link sent.
pairs.afterCap: The button now says Email unavailable. The explanatory message and page layout are unchanged.

verification: Both captures have no horizontal overflow at 390px and no page errors.
Capture receipts bind image hashes to the recorded source revision, local source patch and matching settings.
notes: No database, inbox delivery or native app behavior is proved by these fixtures.
PR #620 still requires a coordinated native onboarding rollout: the released iOS client cannot forward the new invite token.
Local review fixes are uncommitted and have not been deployed.
